info.description: The API of the Interlinea team server: accounts and roles, projects and their files, segments and work, translation memories, termbases and the review of their changes, and a live feed of changes. Requests and answers are JSON (UTF-8), except file uploads and downloads, which say their type. Every answer that is not a success has an Error body with a stable code. Writes to things that have a version (projects, segments, entries, units, accounts, templates) carry the version they were made from, in If-Match or ?version=; a write made from an older version is refused with 409 conflict, and the app reloads. Sign in with a password (/api/auth/password), through the identity provider (/api/auth/oidc/start), or as the first administrator (/api/setup). The answer's token goes in "Authorization: Bearer <token>". The web app the server serves itself asks for a cookie instead (X-Interlinea-Session: cookie on the sign-in): it is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, and every request it signs in must carry the X-Interlinea header. Roles on projects, memories and termbases are read < suggest < edit < approve < manage, given per resource or for all of a kind; administrators may do everything. The desktop app's core, interlinea-core, serves the same API on the person's own computer, for them alone: on the loopback interface, with one account and a token it hands the app when it starts.
